description: Horizontal toolbar with a start section (title + child content) and an actions section. role=toolbar with a roving tabindex (ArrowLeft/Right, Home/End). Overflow=Menu moves the lowest-priority buttons into a More menu (a dropdown that is a bottom sheet on phones); Labels controls the visible button text. Supports sticky positioning.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Optional title displayed at the start of the toolbar.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Content for the left/start section of the toolbar.

parameters.name: Actions
parameters.description: Content for the right/actions section of the toolbar.

parameters.name: Sticky
parameters.description: When true, the toolbar sticks to the top of its scroll container.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the root element.

parameters.name: Overflow
parameters.description: What happens when the buttons do not fit. None keeps every button as written; Menu moves the lowest-priority buttons into a More menu and keeps OverflowOnly buttons there.

parameters.name: Labels
parameters.description: Whether icon buttons show their text. Auto shows it except on a toolbar narrower than TmBreakpoints.Sm (640px), measured on the toolbar itself; a button's own LabelPosition of Hidden always wins.

parameters.name: OverflowLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name and title of the More trigger. Falls back to the localized default.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: Accessible name of the toolbar. Falls back to Title, then the localized default.

parameters.name: OverflowPresentation
parameters.description: How the More menu presents on a phone-sized viewport. Auto is the bottom sheet; a toolbar whose actions need the editor focus or selection to stay put sets Popover.

examples.title: Toolbar with title and action buttons
examples.code:
<TmToolbar Title="Orders">
    <Actions>
        <TmToolbarButton Text="Export" Icon="download" OnClick="@HandleExport" />
        <TmToolbarButton Text="New" Icon="plus" Variant="ButtonVariant.Primary" OnClick="@HandleNew" />
    </Actions>
</TmToolbar>

examples.title: Overflow toolbar with priorities and labels below the icons
examples.code:
<TmToolbar Overflow="ToolbarOverflow.Menu" Labels="ToolbarLabels.IconsWithText" AriaLabel="Diagram tools">
    <TmToolbarButton Icon="save" Text="Save" LabelPosition="ToolbarLabelPosition.Below" />
    <TmToolbarButton Icon="copy" Text="Copy" Priority="ToolbarButtonPriority.Secondary" />
    <TmToolbarButton Icon="trash" Text="Delete" Priority="ToolbarButtonPriority.OverflowOnly" />
</TmToolbar>
